typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	File as string (),
	FileLocation as string (),
	FileLocation_Archive as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	StartDate as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		{segment identifier} as string,
		{lab record identifier} as string,
		{lab record Identifier modifier} as string,
		{member identifier} as string,
		{member identifier modifier} as string,
		{lab providr entity name} as string,
		{loinc code} as string,
		{lab test results text} as string,
		{results units name 01} as string,
		{results units name 02} as string,
		{client record key} as string,
		LAB_TEST_DOS_STR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [segment identifier]       ,[lab record identifier]       ,[lab record Identifier modifier]       ,[member identifier]       ,[member identifier modifier]       ,[lab providr entity name]       ,[loinc code]       ,[lab test results text]       ,[results units name 01]       ,[results units name 02]       ,[client record key] 	  ,LAB_TEST_DOS_STR   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[Optum].[BIOREF_EXTRACT_OPTUM]   UNION    SELECT  [segment identifier]       ,[lab record identifier]       ,[lab record Identifier modifier]       ,[member identifier]       ,[member identifier modifier]       ,[lab providr entity name]       ,[loinc code]       ,[lab test results text]       ,[results units name 01]       ,[results units name 02]       ,[client record key] 	  ,LAB_TEST_DOS_STR   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[Optum].[LABCORP_EXTRACT_OPTUM]   UNION    SELECT  [segment identifier]       ,[lab record identifier]       ,[lab record Identifier modifier]       ,[member identifier]       ,[member identifier modifier]       ,[lab providr entity name]       ,[loinc code]       ,[lab test results text]       ,[results units name 01]       ,[results units name 02]       ,[client record key]        ,LAB_TEST_DOS_STR   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[Optum].[QUEST_EXTRACT_OPTUM]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of LAB_TEST_DOS_STR} = LAB_TEST_DOS_STR) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		lab_record_Identifier_modifier as string,
		client_record_key as string,
		lab_test_results_text as string,
		results_units_name_02 as string,
		lab_record_identifier as string,
		results_units_name_01 as string,
		lab_providr_entity_name as string,
		loinc_code as string,
		segment_identifier as string,
		member_identifier as string,
		lab_test_dos as string,
		member_identifier_modifier as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		lab_record_Identifier_modifier = {Copy of lab record Identifier modifier},
		client_record_key = {Copy of client record key},
		lab_test_results_text = {Copy of lab test results text},
		results_units_name_02 = {Copy of results units name 02},
		lab_record_identifier = {Copy of lab record identifier},
		results_units_name_01 = {Copy of results units name 01},
		lab_providr_entity_name = {Copy of lab providr entity name},
		loinc_code = {Copy of loinc code},
		segment_identifier = {Copy of segment identifier},
		member_identifier = {Copy of member identifier},
		lab_test_dos = {Copy of LAB_TEST_DOS_STR},
		member_identifier_modifier = {Copy of member identifier modifier})) ~> FlatFileDestination1
